result.limitation: Validate assumptions and current AWS documentation. This is not an official AWS review, security audit, deployment or price quote.

paths.risk: Instructions embedded in content the agent reads
Instructions embedded in content the agent reads
Instructions embedded in results of trusted tools

controls.control: Separate instructions from data: wrap every untrusted source in delimiters and label it as data in the prompt
Allowlist tools per task; the model cannot discover or call tools outside the allowlist
Per-operation approval for mutating tools (issue_refund, send_email)
Bind authorization to operation + resource + input digest; model output is never authorization
Egress allowlist for tools that reach the network (send_email); block arbitrary URLs
Output filtering: scan answers and tool arguments for secrets, canary tokens and URLs not present in sources
Canary strings in private data; alert if they appear in outbound calls
Bounded steps, tokens and cost per task; stop on loops
Log tool name, argument digest and outcome; never raw private prompts
Adversarial eval set re-run on every change (agent_eval_plan)
